registered_before: any P5-N2 run is scored. Disclosure: the change was made after the P5-N2 measurement audit (PR #26) and after the blind state envelope, in which sgb-screen-05 (N1-N4) and sgb-screen-09 (N1) were flagged not sustained; no discharge current, thrust or residual from any N2 run has been inspected.

rule.NUMERICAL_FAILURE: the solver crashes, diverges or cannot establish a solution (retcode != success, or non-finite state)
rule.extinction: a numerically valid run (retcode success, finite state) that evolves to extinction at a setpoint the experiment sustained is FAIL_VALIDATION with reason SUSTAINMENT, not NUMERICAL_FAILURE: it is physics-model evidence against the candidate
rule.blind_envelope_runs: the blind state-envelope flags for sgb-screen-05 and -09 are not verdicts; only the pre-registered campaign runs are scored

operational_definition_of_extinction: p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json -> operational_rules.O1_extinction_SUSTAINMENT (persistent terminal collapse; the bridge 'sustained' flag is diagnostic only)
